The '''''Krayt Fang''''' was a [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] that belonged to [[Trex]], a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] in the employ of [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Teemo/Legends|Teemo]]. The ''Krayt Fang'' was docked at [[Landing Bay Aurek]], in [[Mos Shuuta/Legends|Mos Shuuta]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on Tatooine, with a broken [[hypermatter reactor igniter]]. A group of adventurers stole the ship to escape from Teemo the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Thug/Legends|thugs]], as well as [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] led by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Herkin]], an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] commander with illegal connections to Teemo.
